# NotchNest

> NotchNest is a free macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a productivity hub — AI clipboard, calendar briefings, notes, Pomodoro timer, music controls, file drop (AirDrop-style), a camera mirror, and a battery capsule. Available on the Mac App Store.

Key facts:
- Platform: macOS (MacBook Pro/Air with notch; also works on non-notch Macs)
- Price: Free on the Mac App Store
- Website: https://notchnest.app
- Category: Menu bar / notch utility, productivity
